pages.text: The shapeshifting lord of the nether's rifts, bound by the darkest of rites.$(br2)Summoned with a $(l:rituals/sabbath_ritual)Sabbath Ritual$(): Chaotic Essence on the altar, with two Great Essences, an Ender Pearl and Netherite Scrap.$(br2)$(italic)Requires Knights Quest.$()

pages.title: As a Servant
pages.text: It shifts between its Fire, Ice and Magic forms at two thirds and a third of its health, sends up to eight clones and its orbs after your foes, and blinks away when struck.$(br2)Its curse of darkness falls only on its target.
When it falls, it leaves its soul behind. On a Dark Altar it rises again for 500 souls.
